verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents schema-driven structured extraction. Developers can call `page.extract(prompt, schema)` with a JSON schema or pass a `data_extraction_schema` to `run_task`, and task runs accept an optional JSON schema for structured output instead of raw text. Missing for 10: documentation that outputs are actually validated against the schema (or how mismatches are handled), native Zod/Pydantic model support rather than raw JSON schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
